title: Build Grave Accord with 63 bosses and the original Early Watch encounters
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord now runs 63 distinct boss identities across five modes, seven classes, 378 skills, 28 weapons and six map layouts. Each boss has its own original theme. Fixed grades use -- / - / no sign / + / ++, Brutal adds B and secrets display >10. Global difficulty and squad scaling remain separate.

The Early Watch expansion adds Ashen Usher 1--, Brass Toad 1- and Ragpicker's Kite 1. Breakable ticket stands cancel delayed aisle volleys; locked physical hops emit gapped ripples and a drain plug interrupts the tongue; breakable pins remove warned wind corridors around an orbiting kite. Each has three ordinary phases, additional Brutal mechanics and a fourth phase. Wind uses the same bounded force in authority and prediction. Weak-point placement preserves weapon access outside the boss body and cover.

Thirty-six complete new selected poses bring the runtime total to 1,502. Four-frame defeat timing, world/combat-clock conversion and exact live/settled fallback crops are explicit. Native returns, issued requests, all alpha-bearing RGBA and component ownership are preserved; loading version 4 retains every version-3 reference byte. Three new original scores and fifteen-locale names/help/phase labels complete the content integration. All sixty earlier PCM masters remain unchanged.

Protocol 15 keeps online/signed state strict and migrates issued protocol-14 local Practice saves without losing fixed-grade cards, progress or run identity. Roster-dependent progress/profile bounds preserve more than sixty discoveries. Existing profile/cosmetic systems, all seven kits, bank-safe secret consent and five run modes remain implemented.

Hollow Constable's separate phase/mobility/Brutal pass remains available for human comparison in frozen preview 5178. Five revised secondary maps, six ground deliveries, remapped controls, seven basic survivor motion sets, bounded boss texture loading and the direct Solo Standard/Brutal selector remain included. A single ledger and shared journal keep local/in-game/Wiki progress current.

Validation: 394 automated tests, authored-content and all fifteen locale checks, TypeScript and production build pass locally. New regressions exercise actual hostile emissions and landing damage, real weapon hits/cancellation, all six map collisions, wind prediction parity, four-frame defeat clocks, issued-save/profile round trips and real two-client replication/cleanup. Independent native/atlas/fallback reconstruction and all 64 objective compressed-audio checks pass. Exact source/artifact digests and failed attempts are preserved under reviews/early-watch-integration-2026-10-25/.

This remains a draft and the game is unfinished. The source has 62 ordinary bosses and one secret; 88 additional ordinary identities remain toward at least 150 ordinary plus secrets. Fifty-nine original-boss quality assessments/redesigns, seven ability-changing class revamps and the optional branching tree remain. Detailed human map, rendered animation, balance/listening, native-language, physical-device, mixed-progression load/endurance/WAN, hosted recovery/rankings and coordinated release gates stay open.

The canonical Wiki has 18 pages and 28 images; its committed source is published and verified separately. Protected main, the older public protocol-4 Site, immutable protocol-13 Windows development ZIP and all frozen previews remain separate. No merge, deployment, paid provisioning or contest submission is included.
